notes.title: Auto-Play Returns
notes.content:
Today we have posted a new update for Maid Cafe, that brings back the Auto-play option to the game, which is now accessible in two ways.

1. Via the Escape Menu, a new option is available: Auto-Forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23877646/343ae6a729e7aecb21e3791103baf24bdc777a6a.png[/img]

This allows you to toggle the auto-forward mode on and off via the main menu, with it showing with a circle around it when toggled on.

2. Via the new shortcut Shift + K + N on the keyboard, which will also toggle it on or off as needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23877646/aece8f64a4e6f3e4caf70b37e54ee0d9ddaff0e0.png[/img]

This shortcut now appears in the keyboard controls help screen as well.

The settings for the text appearance and how fast it moves to the next dialogue screen can be adjusted via the following options in the games settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23877646/f838841dc60b1084e22187e88a7f44d0514f31c1.png[/img]

[i]N.b. Manually moving text forward via a key, gamepad or mouse whilst auto-forward is activated will usually deactivate it.[/i]

notes.title: Staying True to Your Waifu!
notes.content:
Version 1.5 of Maid Cafe went live today, featuring a variety of new in-game content for players to enjoy if they so wish to...

Whilst the update includes a variety of minor error fixes and the final solution to our artefact box issue mentioned in the last update it also includes some key changes and new options within the game that will allow you to stay truer to your chosen Waifu of Maid Cafe.

[b]Specifically the option to reject women when they come onto you...[/b]

This update includes the following new choices:
[list]
[*]Added the option to decline Gemma if she comes onto you on the first morning.
[*]Included a new option to decline Lucy when she approaches you during your interview.
[*]Included a new option to decline Emma when she approaches you during your interview.
[*]Included a new option to decline Abigail when she approaches you during your interview.
[*]Added a last chance refusal of Josie, if she comes onto you in the apartment.
[*]Added an option to reject Shelby's Advance if you end up closing up with her on the first Tuesday.
[/list]
In addition some decisions have been altered as follows:
[list]
[*]Changed the first choice when you meet Natalia, to make it clearer what will happen after.
[*]Changed the choice descriptions when talking to Shaun as Michelle to make them clearer.
[/list]
Many of these decisions and changes also lead to new alternative events within the game, also by request we have added some additional choices to the 'gender bending' segment of the game on the First Wednesday when Michael is transformed into Michelle. Now you can more soundly reject Shaun should he get to amorous for your liking... Which in turn will alter how the days events unfold.

[i]Finally, this update also sees the options to reject Angela and Spiders special events when interacting them as part of the Sexy Secrets DLC bonus content, if you want to stay true to your chosen Waifu![/i]

We have also resolved the Crossed box issue that has been occurring in dialogue since we upgraded the games base engine edition to ensure steam deck would work. This more odd grammatical issue should also now be resolved in this update.

Thank you to all the players who have been posting errors on our discord server. Thanks to you it makes it much easier for us to find and resolve these final issues in the game.

notes.title: Soundtrack, Steamdeck & Sale

Today we are happy to announce several major updates to Maid Cafe:

Our first announcement is that Maid Cafe is officially SteamDeck compatible, with us resolving the freezing issue that was occurring with the game previously. Steam have re-reviewed the game and confirmed it is now playable on the SteamDeck.

The soundtrack is also now included in the Maid Cafe Ultimate Edition Bundle for those who have that so you can complete your DLC set and get an even greater discount on the new DLC.

[h1]Maid Cafe Sale Event[/h1]
Finally with this release we are happy to announce a new special sale for Maid Cafe and all its DLC, which gives those who are missing any DLC a further discount to complete the set, this discount also stacks with the extra discount offered with the Deluxe and Ultimate Bundles.
